title: A non-holder's observation note does not nudge the writer to claim
outcome: A non-holder's observation note does not nudge the writer to claim
acceptance: A note by a session that does not hold the item is recorded as an observation, and its receipt says so; its reminders never include 'claim it before execution' and its first next command is a read (show or next), not claim

On unclaimed work the observation receipt may offer claim only as a later next command, labelled as the way to execute it; a holder's note keeps today's guidance; focus, rights and the recorded observation are unchanged
Tests cover a non-holder observation on unclaimed work, one on work held by another session, and a holder's note

completion.summary: A non-holder's note on open work is an observation, and its receipt no longer nudges the writer to claim. It has no 'claim it before execution' reminder; its first next command is the read `engram work next --peek`, with the item's own `show --notes` read kept as the receipt's full-detail line. On unclaimed work the claim comes last, with a reminder naming it as the way to execute the item. The guidance follows the recorded result.non_holder; holder notes, focus, rights and the recorded observation are unchanged.
